newsitem.title: USA: ADE to file for public offering.
newsitem.headline: ADE to file for public offering.

text.p: ADE Corp said Tuesday it intends to file for a public offering for up to 2.5 million shares of common stock.
Of the shares proposed to be offered, 2 million shares will be offered by the company and up to about 500,000 shares will be offered by certain stockholders.

ADE and the selling stockholders will grant to the underwriters of the proposed offering an option to purchase up to an additional 15 percent of the shares offered, solely to cover any over-allotments.
The company said it intends to use proceeds for general corporate purposes, including research and development, and for potential acquisitions of complementary businesses and technologies.
ADE is a supplier of metrology and inspection systems for the silicon wafer and computer disk manufacturing industries.
